final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as percentage FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'    -- 66.15% of Marvel Comics superheroes are good
